description: BOSTON, MA—This week, Giffords PAC announced its endorsement of Attorney General Andrea Joy Campbell's campaign for re-election, citing her fearless record fighting gun violence, holding gun traffickers accountable, and protecting Massachusetts' landmark gun safety laws.

title: Giffords PAC Endorses Attorney General Andrea Joy Campbell for Re-Election - Andrea Joy Campbell for Attorney General
